Starts the workflow on what happens to its own orders after the runs that placed them: a resting order filling, what is left of it cancelled or expired, a live trade failing on chain. An item each, paper and live.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trigger.orderActivity` |
| Kind | Trigger: starts executions |
| Outputs | `main` |

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Events (`events`) | list of text | no | `filled`, `canceled`, `expired`, `failed` | filled: a resting order filled, in part or wholly. canceled: what was left of it was cancelled, by Cancel orders, its Trading view, Polymarket or its market resolving. expired: a GTD's time came. failed: a live trade failed on chain and the books undid it. One of `filled`, `canceled`, `expired`, `failed`. |

## Items

Each item has these fields. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `event` | text, one of `filled`, `canceled`, `expired`, `failed` | What happened: filled, canceled, expired or failed. |
| `mode` | text, one of `paper`, `live` | paper or live. |
| `order` | object | The order, as it is now. |
| `order.id` | text | Its ID in the workflow's orders: Cancel orders cancels it by it. |
| `order.status` | text | open, filled, partial, canceled, expired or failed. |
| `order.side` | text, one of `buy`, `sell` | buy or sell. |
| `order.type` | text | FAK, FOK, GTC or GTD. |
| `order.tokenId` | text | The outcome's token ID. |
| `order.marketId` | text; or null | The market's condition ID. |
| `order.price` | decimal | Its limit. |
| `order.shares` | decimal | Shares asked for; zero for a buy of dollars. |
| `order.filled` | decimal | Shares it filled so far. |
| `order.dollars` | decimal | Dollars they came to. |
| `order.fees` | decimal | Fees paid, in dollars. |
| `order.reason` | text; or null | How it stands, or why it ended. |
| `order.trader` | text; or null | The wallet whose trade it copied, if any. |
| `fills` | list of objects | For filled and failed: the fills it is about. |
| `fills[].price` | decimal | Its price per share. |
| `fills[].shares` | decimal | Its shares. |
| `fills[].dollars` | decimal | Shares times price. |
| `fills[].fee` | decimal | Its fee, in dollars; a maker pays none. |
| `at` | time | When it was seen. |
